$comment: Findings the CodeQL gate should not block on. Keep this list empty when you can.
Every entry needs a `reason` a reviewer can check and an `expires` date (YYYY-MM-DD).
An expired entry fails the build on purpose, so a silenced finding cannot be forgotten.
`rule` is the CodeQL ruleId and `path` is the file path exactly as it appears in the SARIF.
See SECURITY.md > Handling a false positive.
